theorem_contract.affine_core_scope: Reducing affine-incidence cores imply shorted equality, but are not necessary: label-distinct W3 has balanced emergent nonreducing intersections.
theorem_contract.balance_if_and_only_if: Every fractional eigenvalue is 1/2 iff G_A=G_B, equivalently the shorted operators of A and B to K are equal.
theorem_contract.constructive_boundary: An equality theorem still requires coherent transforms for the child intersection and its compressed range metric.
theorem_contract.fractional_metric_pencil: For K=ran(A) intersect ran(B), the fractional spectrum of S^-1/2 A S^-1/2 equals the generalized spectrum of (G_B,G_A+G_B), where G_A=U^*A^+U and G_B=U^*B^+U.
theorem_contract.new_all_n_target: Prove or falsify equality of the two compressed pseudoinverse metrics for every natural collision-free affine split.
